title: Small Group Tampa Sightseeing City Bus Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Tampa with us! Discover Tampa like never before on our Sightseeing City Bus Tour — a small-group experience in a comfortable, air-conditioned minibus, limited to just 12 guests. Explore the city's vibrant local art scene, enjoy great food options, learn interesting facts about Tampa's great architecture, delve into the history of the Scrub neighborhood, and stroll through Ybor City, the famed Cigar Capital. Along the way, enjoy sweeping, non-stop views of the beautiful Bay.
